text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — NimblePay POC. Need to lock use cases + endpoints for next week's demo. TL;DR: 2 primary journeys, prioritize eval prompts, timeline, security asks, and pricing. Who's on?
Alex Chen: I'm in. Suggest we narrow to: 1) support reply suggestion (chat) 2) invoice data extraction + validation (embeddings/NER). Both realistic and demo-friendly.
Sam Rodgers: Agree. Proposed POC endpoints: /chat/reply, /embeddings/extract, /ner/validate. Need sample payloads and a lightweight harness. Timeline: can we be dev-ready in 4 business days?
Priya Nair: Flagging security: they want SOC2 attestation, KMS key separation, and IP/data ownership language. Also asked about EU data residency — they need it. I'll prep the security questionnaire answers today.
Lia Gómez: Success criteria suggestions: p95 latency <500ms for chat, extraction F1 >=0.85 on our eval set, cost target < $0.10 per 1k tokens. UX: show 3 suggestion variants for reply.
Maya Patel: Good constraints. Alex / Sam — can you draft minimal prompts + eval cases? Example for reply suggestion: 5 real tickets + expected tone/length.
Alex Chen: On it. Sample prompt snippet:
```prompt
System: You are a helpful payments assistant.
User: <ticket_text>
Assistant: Suggest 3 reply options, each <= 2 sentences, formal tone.
```
I'll produce 5 positive/edge-case examples.
Sam Rodgers: I'll build a tiny eval harness using our similarity checks + manual labels for extraction quality. Question: for chat latency in POC do we want single-shot (no batching) to prioritize responsiveness?
Maya Patel: Yes single-shot for demo. We can try small batching for load tests later.
OpsBot: Deploy job scheduled: dedicated-poc-nimblepay on 1968890000. GPU pool: gtx-p4x-large.
Priya Nair: Procurement asked about spend caps — we can propose a soft monthly cap under Dedicated pricing or a trial credit + committed cap. I'll draft pricing options to present.
Lia Gómez: Also include a rollback/fallback policy: if latency >1s fallback to quantized/distilled model and annotate expected quality loss.
Alex Chen: I'll assemble an endpoint matrix mapping each UI flow to API calls, sample SDK snippets, and a short test payload set. Will post a gist link here when ready (ETA EOD).
Maya Patel: Action items summary: Alex = endpoint matrix + prompts; Sam = eval harness + payloads; Priya = security Q + procurement note; Lia = success metrics doc + rollback plan. Sync tomorrow 10:00 AM. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Adding: NimblePay wants a 2-week POC with a mid-POC check at week 1. We should confirm demo criteria for week 1 (basic integration + one successful extraction flow).
Maya Patel: Noted — include week-1 check in timeline. Thanks everyone, will circulate an updated scope doc after the EOD drops.
